name: switch
summary: Turns a setting on or off as soon as it changes: a track and its thumb, named by its label, with read-only, disabled, required and invalid.

notCovered.name: the touch target
notCovered.why: Under a coarse pointer UI SDK lays an empty box 2.75rem tall over the label, so a tap near the switch reaches it. It draws nothing, so no light reads its size, and the part leaves it as UI SDK sets it.
